integrity: The mathematical claims were checked analytically and with a standalone finite diagnostic; finite computations are not substitutes for the all-parameter proof. The related 2024 paper was examined only at abstract level. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusions concern only exact-real dynamics on the strict-alternation domain \(0<c<b<a<1\), not general parameters, other branch itineraries, or numerical cryptographic quality. The fold locations are uniquely defined transcendental quantities. At the cusp and folds neutral multipliers do not imply hyperbolicity. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: A sharp two-cycle cusp and global bistability in the fixed-point-free cosine map
